evals.prompt: Please proofread /tmp/folio-skill-workspace/sample-blog.md and write annotations for all spelling mistakes and unclear phrasing. Use the folio sidecar at /tmp/folio-skill-workspace/sample-blog.folio.
evals.expected_output: A valid .folio sidecar with replace/delete annotations for all spelling errors. context_before and target must use plain rendered text only (no markdown syntax). All resolved fields false.

assertions.text: Output file is valid JSON with version:1
assertions.check: parse the .folio output as JSON; top-level keys include 'version' (value 1) and 'annotations' (array)

assertions.text: All annotations have resolved:false and source:agent
assertions.check: every annotation has resolved=false and source='agent'
every annotation id matches the pattern ann_[a-z0-9]{8}

assertions.text: No markdown syntax in context_before or target
assertions.check: no annotation's context_before or target field contains '#', '**', '__', or backtick characters
at least 5 of these misspellings are targeted: 'worlds', 'Wether', 'importent', 'rosted', 'excelent', 'courser', 'exeptional'
every annotation has a non-empty context_before string

evals.prompt: Review /tmp/folio-skill-workspace/sample-readme.md for safety and documentation issues. Add a folio annotation pointing out that the docs say the sync operation is 'irreversible' but don't explain how to restore from backup. Also flag the --force flag description as insufficient. Write the annotations to /tmp/folio-skill-workspace/sample-readme.folio.
evals.expected_output: A valid .folio sidecar with at least 2 annotations: one on the 'irreversible' sentence, one on the --force flag. context_before uses plain text.

assertions.text: Output file is valid JSON with version:1
assertions.check: parse the .folio output as JSON; has 'version':1 and 'annotations' array
annotations array has at least 2 entries

assertions.text: One annotation addresses the irreversible warning
assertions.check: at least one annotation's target or comment or context_before contains 'irreversible'
at least one annotation's target or comment or context_before contains '--force' or 'force'

assertions.text: No markdown syntax in context_before or target
assertions.check: no annotation's context_before or target contains backtick, '##', or '**' characters

evals.prompt: I have a markdown file at /tmp/folio-skill-workspace/sample-blog.md. Please add a folio annotation suggesting we change the title 'How to Make Great Coffee' to 'Brewing the Perfect Cup: A Beginner's Guide'. Write it to /tmp/folio-skill-workspace/sample-blog-title.folio.
evals.expected_output: A single 'replace' annotation. target='How to Make Great Coffee' (no # prefix). replacement='Brewing the Perfect Cup: A Beginner's Guide'.

assertions.text: Output file is valid JSON with version:1
assertions.check: parse the .folio output as JSON; has 'version':1 and 'annotations' array

assertions.text: Exactly one annotation of kind replace
assertions.check: annotations array has exactly one entry with kind='replace'

assertions.text: Target is plain title text without # prefix
assertions.check: the replace annotation's target is 'How to Make Great Coffee' (no leading #)

assertions.text: Replacement matches the requested new title
assertions.check: the replace annotation's replacement is "Brewing the Perfect Cup: A Beginner's Guide"
